description: Funnel login fix: POST bodies are now read with Content-Length or chunked framing (proxies may forward login without Content-Length, which used to arrive as empty credentials and answer 401), and the session cookie is HTTPS-safe (Secure + SameSite=None) so the browser keeps the session over the funnel and the WS socket stays connected.
features: Chunked-aware request body reader: login/auth/chat/STT bodies decode correctly whether the proxy sends Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding: chunked.
HTTPS-safe session cookie (Secure + SameSite=None) so login over the funnel persists and /ws stays authed.
Version synced to 0.17.1 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
